blocks.text: BANGA, South Cotabato — Vice President Sara Duterte on Monday morning visited two families who lost their children in the Sept. 18 shooting at Banga National High School, offering her condolences and financial assistance. READ: DILG, PNP chiefs visit Banga school after deadly shooting Speaking to reporters, Duterte said schools should strengthen what she called a “culture of security” and act on information about possible threats, even if they initially appear minor. “It is very important to implement a culture of security inside our schools,” Duterte said.
